name: prompt-forge-trifactor
description: Build complicated prompts one idea at a time. Every Enter merges an idea into a structured prompt, contradictions surface instead of being guessed away, and Polish rewrites it for the model you are sending it to. Works with your own Claude, Gemini, or OpenAI login, or any API key.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Prompt Forge runs a vendor CLI as a child process and sends prompts to an endpoint you configure. Paths and endpoints are not read from an untrusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Needs a real filesystem for the prompt library and a process host for the vendor CLIs.

promptForge.libraryPath.markdownDescription: Folder holding one `<name>.md` (the prompt) and one `<name>.forge.json` (its history) per prompt. Created on first use. `~` is your home folder.

enumDescriptions: The first provider you are signed in to (CLI login first, then a stored API key).
Claude: the `claude` CLI login or an Anthropic API key.
Gemini: the `gemini` CLI login or a Google AI Studio API key.
OpenAI: the `codex` CLI login or an OpenAI API key.
Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter, ...).
promptForge.engine.provider.description: Which account runs the engine. Independent of the target model the prompt is written for.

promptForge.engine.mergeModel.description: Model used on every Enter to merge an idea into the document. `auto` picks the provider's fast model.

promptForge.engine.polishModel.description: Model used by Polish and by every target-model change. `auto` picks the provider's best model.

promptForge.engine.timeoutSeconds.description: Hard limit for one engine call.

promptForge.engine.recentEntries.description: How many already-merged ideas the engine is shown as context on each merge.

enumDescriptions: Side by side while there is room, stacked when the panel is narrower than the width below.
Always side by side. Both panels squeeze rather than stack.
Always stacked: Ideas above, Prompt below.
promptForge.layout.description: How the Ideas and Prompt panels sit next to each other.

promptForge.layoutStackWidth.markdownDescription: With `#promptForge.layout#` set to `auto`, stack the panels once the working area is narrower than this many pixels. `0` never stacks.

promptForge.layoutSplit.description: Share of the working area given to Ideas, as a percentage. Drag the divider between the panels to change it.

promptForge.railCollapsed.description: Collapse the Prompts list to a strip. Click the chevron on the list, or run Prompt Forge: Toggle the Prompts List.

promptForge.projectRoots.markdownDescription: Folders the picker may **list** when you attach a project. Their immediate children that look like projects (a `.git` or a manifest) become the picker's contents. Names and paths only — nothing in these folders is ever read. Empty means the picker offers the open workspace and Browse.

enumDescriptions: Send the attached project's brief with every merge and polish.
promptForge.projectContext.description: Whether an attached project's brief is sent to the engine. Nothing is read until you attach a folder to a prompt.

enumDescriptions: Attach the folder VS Code has open.
Attach nothing; pick a project per prompt.

promptForge.projectMaxFiles.description: Hard cap on how many files are considered when building a project brief.

promptForge.projectMaxBytes.description: Hard cap on how many bytes are read when building a project brief.

promptForge.cli.claudePath.markdownDescription: Path to the `claude` binary. Empty finds it on PATH.

promptForge.cli.geminiPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `gemini` binary. Empty finds it on PATH.

promptForge.cli.codexPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `codex` binary. Empty finds it on PATH.

promptForge.compatible.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API, e.g. `http://localhost:11434/v1` (Ollama) or `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`. The optional key is stored with *Prompt Forge: Set an API Key*.

enumDescriptions: Prompt Forge's own editor: the document formatted, click any part to edit it. Nothing to install.
Office Viewer's WYSIWYG markdown editor, if you have that extension installed.
The plain text editor, markdown source.
promptForge.docEditor.description: How the prompt document opens beside the panel.

promptForge.sourcePath.markdownDescription: Developer setting. Absolute path to a working copy of the extension. When set, `src/` and `media/` are loaded from there and reloaded on save without restarting the extension host.

promptForge.autoReload.markdownDescription: Developer setting. Reload automatically when a file under `promptForge.sourcePath` changes.
